card.name: The word Clinical in label headings
card.fires_on: The word "Clinical" (or its start, "Clin") and sometimes "findings", in drug-label text. It appears in section headings and cross-references like "Clinical Pharmacology" and "Clinical Effect(s)", and in phrases like "Good clinical practice".

modes.label: Clinical in headings
modes.description: "Clinical" opens a section title or cross-reference, such as Clinical Worsening or Clinical Pharmacology.
